:::{#about-hero}

I am data scientist at the French National Institute of Statistics ([Insee](https://www.insee.fr/fr/accueil)). My work focuses on leveraging new data sources and innovative methods to develop reliable statistics on socioeconomic phenomena. I have a particular interest in the analysis of textual and spatial data.

I mostly work with `Python`, {{< fa brands r-project >}} and `Javascript`. Most of my projects, both personal and professional, are available on my {{< fa brands github >}} [GitHub page](https://github.com/linogaliana) or the {{< fa brands github >}} [GitHub page](https://github.com/inseefrlab) of Insee's Lab. A selection is featured in the [projects section](#projects) below, including a few inspired by my love of cycling 🚲. I also teach a few courses, more on that in the [teaching section](#teaching).

:::

## Teaching

I currently teach [*Python for Data Scientists*](https://pythonds.linogaliana.fr/) {{< fa brands python >}} in two of France's top engineering schools (at [ENSAE Institut Polytechnique](https://www.ensae.fr/) and [ENSAI](https://ensai.fr/)). You can find the course materials on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/linogaliana/python-datascientist) {{< fa brands github >}}.

I also teach a course on [_Data Science Projects in Production_](https://ensae-reproductibilite.github.io/website/) at ENSAE. This course addresses state-of-the-art MLOps practices, with materials available on the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ensae-reproductibilite/website) {{< fa brands github >}}.

I have also developed several other courses in the past:

- [Good practices in `R` and `Git`](https://inseefrlab.github.io/formation-bonnes-pratiques-git-R/)
- An [introduction to {{< fa brands r-project >}}](https://rgeo.linogaliana.fr/) ([GitHub repository](https://github.com/linogaliana/r-geographie) {{< fa brands github >}}), taught as an introductory data analysis course at [Ecole Normale Supérieure](https://www.geographie.ens.psl.eu/introduction-aux-methodes.html)
- A course on [new data sources](https://inseefrlab.github.io/cours-nouvelles-donnees-slides/slides/index.html#/title-slide), now taught by Insee colleagues.

## Open source projects

Among my main open source projects, I maintain [`utilitR`](https://www.utilitr.org/), a collective, community-driven documentation effort for the {{< fa brands r-project >}} software within the French administration, and [`cartiflette`](https://inseefrlab.github.io/cartiflette-website/), which gives data scientists easy access to France's official geographic boundaries for mapping.

I also enjoy turning my professional tools toward personal projects — [climbtracker](https://github.com/linogaliana/climbtracker) ⛰️🚲 is one such example, helping road cyclists find nearby climbs.
